policy.publicNames: __all__ when present, otherwise non-underscore module attributes; NLTK-owned classes and routines (including bound tokenizer helpers) are targets. Other attributes are listed as exclusions, not silently dropped.
policy.classMembers: Public callable members are discovered, including inherited members. Mapping a class does not map all its members.
policy.bunExports: Runtime value exports of every package.json Bun entrypoint. Type-only exports and nested namespace members are excluded; name presence is not behavioral evidence.
policy.behavior: Evidence is case-scoped, never full parity. Existing tests are references, not a record that the generator executed them. Unreviewed names default to gaps.
